caption: One meal for the whole family 🤍 This is the kind of dinner that makes life easier — no separate meals, just one dish everyone can enjoy. Mushroom Lamb Ingredients: • 1 lb lamb • 1 small onion • 3 garlic cloves • 4 oz mushrooms • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • ½ tsp oregano • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 dash cinnamon • Salt (skip for babies under 1) • ½ cup water Instructions: Brown lamb in butter and olive oil. Add onion, garlic, and spices. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Add water and slow cook for 1 hour until tender. Sauté mushrooms separately and mix in at the end. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes. — Meals like this are exactly why I created my app 🤍 Because figuring out what to cook every day can feel like a lot.
